name: MINOR IN CONCEPTUAL ASTRONOMY
title: MINOR IN CONCEPTUAL ASTRONOMY Faculty of Science - Physics and Astronomy

sections.heading: MINOR IN CONCEPTUAL ASTRONOMY
lines: Faculty of Science - Physics and Astronomy

This Minor is especially designed for students with a general interest in Astronomy. Students enrolled in any other module offered by the Department of Physics and Astronomy cannot simultaneously be enrolled in this Minor.
0.5 course at the 2000 level or above from the Faculty of Science.

2.5 courses from: Astronomy 2201A/B, Astronomy 2801A/B, (Astronomy 2232F/G or Earth Sciences 2232F/G), Earth Sciences 2200A/B, Earth Sciences 2240F/G, Earth Sciences 3001A/B, Earth Sciences 4312A/B, Earth Sciences 4321A/B, Geography and Environment 2090A/B, Philosophy 2300F/G, Philosophy 2310F/G, Physics 2070A/B, the former Earth Sciences 3312A/B, the former Earth Sciences 3321A/B.
Note: Some courses listed in this module have prerequisites not included in the module.
